protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. In 1.0.2 an authenticated user can store attacker-controlled HTML in HorillaAttachment.description through HorillaAttachmentForm's SummernoteInplaceWidget. The documented Edit action loads that value into Summernote and executes event-handler HTML. A second source-to-sink path renders the same stored value with {{ obj.description|safe }} in notes_attachments_detail.html. The latter remains present in 1.0.3.

It first contains HorillaAttachment.description, the SummernoteWidget binding, the Edit/View routes, and the unsafe detail rendering. History searches for the widget and safe rendering reach that root; 30f6428d558c5d2fa2c164f79f7714eb32e8e359 merely changes SummernoteWidget to SummernoteInplaceWidget.

findings: The primary's BIC, root-parent proof, tag ancestry, and BIC-only NOT_AI judgment independently reproduce.

The primary correctly notices the detail-view {{ obj.description|safe }} sink but then incorrectly sets direct_fix_sha to fc5c8e55988e89273012491b5f097b762b474546 and remaining_gap to null as though that same sink were closed.

At tag 1.0.3, DOMPurify is confined to client-side Summernote handling in static/assets/js/global.js. horilla_generics/templates/notes_attachments_detail.html still renders the stored description with |safe, while HorillaAttachmentForm and HorillaAttachment contain no bleach, DOMPurify, or other server-side sanitizer.

The public PoC's exact Edit-pencil trigger is addressed by fc5c8e55988e89273012491b5f097b762b474546, so the commit remains the advisory patch; it is not evidence that every source-to-sink path described by the primary is fixed.

corrected_fields.reasoning: 14ca79728363441de177fdfb318f203113b816c5 remains the atomic BIC and has no BIC-local AI marker, so NOT_AI remains supported. fc5c8e55988e89273012491b5f097b762b474546 is the direct remediation for the advisory's Edit-pencil PoC, but it does not close the primary's additional direct detail-render sink. A full direct-fix SHA for the complete stated mechanism is therefore not established.
corrected_fields.remaining_gap: No complete fix was established for the persistent notes detail-view sink: tag 1.0.3 still renders HorillaAttachment.description with |safe and has no server-side sanitization. Either narrow bug_semantics strictly to the Edit-pencil PoC or retain the two-sink semantics and mark the detail path unpatched.

remaining_gap: Primary verdict NOT_AI is supportable, but the primary record must correct its complete-fix claim: fc5c8e55988e89273012491b5f097b762b474546 fixes the documented editor trigger while leaving the separately stated detail-render sink unpatched in 1.0.3.
